reading.body:
Megvii's US patent record is small and aging: 16 granted patents, with the five most recent issued between December 2020 and July 2022.

The recent titles cluster tightly around face recognition and authentication: liveness detection, face-to-unlock, and image processing and fusion. That is the applied end of computer vision, the part that ships in a phone or a door reader. The record shows a company that patented deployment methods rather than the training of large models.

The data does not cover Megvii's Chinese filings, its revenue, its products, or any computing infrastructure it owns or rents. It also does not say whether patenting slowed after 2022 or whether the USPTO applicant phrase simply missed later grants. Nothing here speaks to compute, buildings, or power, so no conclusion about AI scaling can be drawn from it.

profile_text.body:
Megvii is a public company headquartered in Beijing, China, founded in 2011. Its website identifies the company as "MEGVII旷视," giving the name in both Latin and Chinese characters.

The material available from the company's own site is limited to that name treatment, so there is no product or technology description to report from it. No products, lawsuits, or MCP servers are recorded for Megvii.
